name: Momotarou
source:
"Let's be off. I know the way by heart."

From the tale "Momotaro."

A young man born from a giant peach floating down a river. As righteous as his gallant appearance would suggest, he sets out on a journey to slay the oni that are making the people's lives miserable. 

[From [url=https://adabanaitan.com/en/]ANIPLEX.EXE[/url]]
